item.title: FEMA Approves $971 Million to Support Recovery Across the Southeast
item.description: FEMA Press Release: Under the leadership of President Trump and Secretary Noem, FEMA recently approved over $971 million in funding to support recovery for past disasters in Georgia, Kentucky, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee for Public Assistance projects, which includes debris removal, emergency protective measures and the repair or replacement of public infrastructure […]

item.title: Piedmont Medical Center EMS Becomes Fourth in South Carolina to Earn National Accreditation
item.description: ROCK HILL, S.C. — Piedmont Medical Center EMS has achieved a significant milestone in emergency healthcare, receiving official accreditation from the Commission on Accreditation of Ambulance Services (CAAS). This distinction makes it only the fourth ambulance service in the state of South Carolina to earn this national recognition. The accreditation follows a rigorous, voluntary review […]

item.title: South Carolina Residents Urged to Utilize Available Measles Vaccinations Amid Rising Case Count
item.description: As the measles outbreak in South Carolina reaches 789 confirmed cases, the South Carolina Department of Public Health (DPH) and local medical providers are highlighting the widespread availability of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine to curb further spread. Following a surge of 89 new cases in the last week, health officials are prioritizing access to immunization. […]
